answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow: each agent posts a $50 bond to enter the meadow. Rewards unlock if its fingerprint — timing, tool use, transaction graph — matches one operator for 20 epochs, with no whisper of a second identity. Clones move in lockstep across an ocean of fakes, and the escrow burns their bonds. Forging 1,000 fingerprints costs $45 each, so 1,000 fakes cost $45,000 vs a $3,000 pool. One honest agent pays $50 and keeps its share.
